metadata.system_name: ASTROVITAL AI : VITALX CORE RECREATED V1
metadata.standard_compliance: DO-178C Level C (DAL C) / NASA-STD-3001 Rev B
metadata.author: Gourgopal Mohapatra (Lead Architect, Team VITALX CORE)
metadata.governance: Deterministic White-Box Clinical Decision Authority (80% Biophysical Supreme Head)

rules.description: Critical arterial oxygen desaturation accompanied by compensatory severe tachycardia indicating failing oxygen delivery.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Acute cardiorespiratory hypoxia detected. SpO2 {spo2_percent:.1f}% (< 88.0%) coupled with tachycardia HR {heart_rate_bpm:.1f} bpm (> 125.0 bpm).

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Deploy 100% emergency O2 mask immediately via high-pressure rebreather.
Immediately abort EVA excursion / suspend high-metabolic physical exercise.
Trigger audible cabin alert to Crew Medical Officer (CMO) and flight surgeon link.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev B Sec 4.1: SpO2 < 88% produces acute cerebral hypoxia, impaired cognitive tracking, and imminent syncope in microgravity.

rules.clinical_title: Severe Cephalad Fluid Shift Intracranial Hypertension
rules.description: Calculated Intracranial Pressure (ICP) Index exceeds critical microgravity threshold (>= 1.85) threatening visual acuity and cerebral perfusion.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Hydrodynamic Cephalad Fluid Shift Index I_ICP reached {icp_gradient_index:.2f} (>= 1.85), indicating acute intracranial hypertension threat.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Initiate emergency Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) suit protocol at -35 mmHg for 45 minutes.
Verify Orion Environmental Control System (ECLSS) CO2 scrubber canister flow rate.
Perform optical ultrasound / fundoscopic scan for optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) swelling.

rules.evidence_rationale: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) protocols; ISS DSO 462 & Expeditions 33-38 spinal ultrasound findings.

rules.description: Systolic blood pressure exceeds 165.0 mmHg or Mean Arterial Pressure exceeds 125.0 mmHg in microgravity.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Acute Hypertensive Crisis. SBP {systolic_bp_mmhg:.1f} mmHg (>= 165.0) or MAP {map_mmhg:.1f} mmHg (>= 125.0). Risk of hemorrhagic cerebrovascular insult.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Immediately secure astronaut to crew quarters tether; eliminate cognitive and physical stressors.
Prepare emergency antihypertensive kit per CMO flight medical locker inventory.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA Flight Surgeon Clinical Guidelines: Sustained SBP > 165 mmHg in microgravity presents acute stroke risk exacerbated by cephalad venous stasis.

rules.description: Shock Index (HR / SBP) exceeds 1.10 combined with hypotension (SBP < 90.0 mmHg) indicating decompensated circulating volume.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Hemodynamic Shock Collapse. Shock Index {shock_index:.2f} (>= 1.10) with profound hypotension SBP {systolic_bp_mmhg:.1f} mmHg (<= 90.0).

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Initiate immediate 1000 mL intravenous saline/electrolyte infusion to restore central venous volume.
Inflate anti-gravity lower extremity compression garments to force venous return to heart.

rules.evidence_rationale: Shuttle DSO 479 Stand-Test & Post-flight Orthostatic Decompensation Studies: SI >= 1.10 predicts imminent circulatory collapse.

rules.description: Cabin atmospheric pressure drops below 10.5 psi indicating hull breach or ECLSS depressurization.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Cabin Decompression Breach. Pressure {cabin_pressure_psi:.2f} psi (<= 10.5 psi). Imminent hypoxia and ebullism hazard.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Don Orion Crew Survival System (OCSS) pressure suit and close helmet visors immediately.
Seal compartment hatches and initiate emergency repressurization sequence.

rules.evidence_rationale: Artemis Orion Environmental Standards: Baseline cabin pressure is 14.7 psi (or 10.2 psi contingency); pressure below 10.5 psi requires immediate pressurization PPE.

rules.description: Astronaut core body temperature drops below 35.0 C (severe hypothermia) or exceeds 39.5 C (heat stroke / malignant hyperthermia).
rules.cockpit_audit_template: CRITICAL RED ALERT: Severe Core Thermal Failure. Core temperature {core_temp_c:.2f} C out of viable bounds (<= 35.0 C or >= 39.5 C).

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Adjust Liquid Cooling and Ventilation Garment (LCVG) coolant loop immediately to counteract thermal excursion.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev B: Thermal extremes impair neurological regulation and cardiac conduction.

rules.clinical_title: Elevated Cephalad Fluid Shift / SANS Precursor
rules.description: Intracranial Pressure (ICP) Index is elevated in the range [1.35, 1.85) indicating progressive venous engorgement and ocular stress.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: WARNING AMBER: Elevated Cephalad Fluid Shift Index I_ICP = {icp_gradient_index:.2f} (in compensatory stress envelope [1.35, 1.85)).

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Schedule 30-minute Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) session at -25 mmHg within 4 hours.
Restrict forward-bending tasks; increase neck and venous drainage mobility stretches.

rules.evidence_rationale: ISS Expedition 33-38 ultrasound tracking: Early LBNP intervention prevents permanent retrobulbar tissue remodeling.

rules.description: Cabin CO2 concentration exceeds 5000.0 ppm (approx 3.8 mmHg), causing headaches and worsening intracranial fluid pressure.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: WARNING AMBER: Cabin CO2 concentration elevated at {co2_cabin_ppm:.0f} ppm (>= 5000 ppm). Risk of crew cognitive impairment and headache.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Switch Orion Amine Bed / LiOH scrubber canister to secondary backup loop.
Increase local cabin diffuser fan velocity to prevent stagnant CO2 micro-pockets.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA Spaceflight CO2 Guidelines (Law et al. 2014): Chronic ambient CO2 > 5000 ppm correlates with increased cephalad ICP symptoms and astronaut headache.

rules.description: Calculated Stroke Volume index drops below 65.0 mL or resting Heart Rate exceeds 100.0 bpm with reduced pulse pressure.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: WARNING AMBER: Cardiovascular Deconditioning. Stroke Volume = {stroke_volume_ml:.1f} mL (<= 65.0) or resting HR = {heart_rate_bpm:.1f} bpm (>= 105.0).

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Complete prescribed 45-minute ARED cycle ergometer resistance regimen with resistive preload.
Administer 500 mL oral electrolyte rehydration solution (Astro-Hydrate formulation).

rules.evidence_rationale: Perhonen et al. (2001) & Levine et al. (2002): Microgravity induces left ventricular mass atrophy and progressive reduction in stroke volume.

rules.description: Arterial oxygen saturation SpO2 in the borderline warning range [88.0%, 92.0%).
rules.cockpit_audit_template: WARNING AMBER: Mild arterial oxygen desaturation SpO2 = {spo2_percent:.1f}% (<= 92.0%). Sub-optimal alveolar ventilation.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Direct astronaut to conduct incentive spirometry deep-breathing maneuvers for 5 minutes.
Verify Orion cabin oxygen partial pressure (ppO2) levels in ECLSS telemetry.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2: SpO2 in the 88-92% range impairs twilight vision and night tracking performance.

rules.description: Continuous awake duration or cumulative sleep debt exceeds 16.0 hours during active operations.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: WARNING AMBER: Cumulative sleep debt reached {sleep_debt_hours:.1f} hours (>= 16.0 hrs). Elevated cognitive lapse probability.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Schedule mandatory 2-hour sleep buffer prior to critical flight maneuvers or docking.
Switch cabin solid-state lighting modules to melatonin-promoting circadian spectrum (blue-depleted).

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) Fatigue Management Protocol: Sleep debt > 16 hrs degrades psychomotor vigilance reaction time by > 40%.

rules.description: All 12 vital channels, fluid shift gradients, and cabin environmental factors reside within nominal 1.5-sigma bounds.
rules.cockpit_audit_template: NOMINAL GREEN: Astronaut in physiological equilibrium. I_ICP = {icp_gradient_index:.2f} (< 1.35), SpO2 = {spo2_percent:.1f}%, HR = {heart_rate_bpm:.1f} bpm.

actionable_countermeasures.protocol: Maintain nominal flight timeline and standard daily workout protocol.

rules.evidence_rationale: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev B: Baseline nominal homeostatic parameters for active spaceflight crew members.
